title: 17章 神威断魂一十三18章 活着到底为什么
lines: 迷离的星光，在淡淡的云烟中隐约闪现。院落中的话题渐渐地发生了不可控的变化，在一群小辈的抓耳挠腮之中，话题从张荼的能力逐渐转移到了男大当婚女大当嫁的话题之上。
傅缃叶深有同感的不断点头附和着。
张顺圣发了一圈烟后，点着闷着抽了一口，无奈地说道：“儿大不由爷，荼都被他娘惯坏了，我说啥，开心了就听，不开心了就当没听到。”
“哪有你这么说自己家孩子的，小荼一直都很孝顺听话，肯定是你态度不好。”
一个看不清容貌的大娘插话道，不过目光中闪现着村里人特有的智慧：“你实话实说，小荼到底有没有意中人。”
傅缃叶犹豫了下，还是说道：“应该是有，也许没有，他的心事向来藏得很深，不过不管有没有，希望都应该不大了。”
从张荼出去之后，再到身边跟随着一个神秘的边关月，傅缃叶就知道，云裳那边，这二人怕是应该发生了什么矛盾。
刘金玉她是知道的，云裳来家里时曾经说过，就在隔壁的小区，这个傻孩子怕是兜了一圈发现，云裳应该便是在河这边。
一切都如傅缃叶预料的一般，果然知子莫若母。
听到傅缃叶的话语之后，那大娘一拍大腿，声调高了一分，但是紧接着连忙压低了声音：“得！这不就结了么？能让如今小荼荼犹豫不决的，可不就是有主了吗？像咱家小荼这样心高气傲的主，怎么回去主动缠着那些有主的。”
“可不能耗着啊，我说荼荼妈，这样是按照荼的意思干耗着，又要好多年哩。”一旁的另外一个大娘，以一副过来人的话语说道：“隔壁庄上有一个就是这样，命里没有，就是差那么多缘分，这不一直耽误到了四十多岁，也没有个暖被窝的，别说多可怜了。”
傅缃叶看着街坊邻居热情的模样，总感觉哪里不对，但是又觉得哪里都对。
看到傅缃叶犹豫的模样，第一个大娘笑了一声，说道：“不说别的，咱周围不是有几个庄子尽出美女么？虽然学识和见识比不上人城里的大家闺秀，可要是论知冷暖，伺候人，那些大小姐又哪里比得上啊。”
不知道是感慨还是什么，大娘的声音略微有些低沉，说不出的韵味：“毕竟，小地方的更有眼力劲儿……”
张顺圣一听，觉得说得对，试探着说道：“缃叶，要不……就听两位嫂子的？先给荼荼把把关，回头真有不错的再给荼荼介绍介绍，这知根知底的，也放心不是？就那小子的懒散模样，要不是一个会伺候人的，我还真不放心。”
傅缃叶心里还想着云裳的模样，以及这两年逢年过节就会发来问候视频的小妮子，虽然从未见过面，但是问候礼品和关心可是一样都没有少。
但是想想也有道理，城里的姑娘虽好，可是那里比得上农家的姑娘勤快和会伺候人呢？
傅缃叶咬咬牙说道：“这么耗下去也不是办法，就这么地吧，麻烦两位嫂子多给留意着，有好姑娘咱先见见，对吧。”
“好说，好说。”
门外的边关月听着话题的转变，不禁有些忍俊不禁，强忍着笑意，拖着一条后腿就走进了院子，看到那快赶上大门宽的后腿，众人不禁为之震撼。
这，这就是张荼独立斩杀出没在庄子周围的野猪么？
“好大啊！”
“这野猪……好生勇悍的荼小子啊。”
张顺圣看着脸不红气不喘的边关月，眼睛微微耷拉着，心里却是对于这不显山不露水的边关月有了一个大致的衡量，好家伙，好大的力气。
尤其是当他注意到边关月的脚步，哪怕是踩在了松软的泥地上，也没有丝毫的脚印留下，心中不由自主地猜测，张荼的造化，是不是就与边关月有关呢？
边关月随手将猪腿拖到了一个角落，笑着说道：“叔，姨，等天亮了你们处理一下，这个肉质啊，绝对的鲜美，这个我不会料理，不然也不麻烦你们二位了。”
张顺圣乐呵呵地递过一根烟，说道：“小边关啊，你可别这么客气，来到这里，就当在自己家一样。这些事儿，就交给叔来。对了，荼荼睡得很死，当真没有什么问题么？”
边关月学着别人的模样，将烟别在耳上，说道：“不妨事儿的，让他好好休息一下，对他的身体有好处。”
话音落罢，便是转身对着众人说道：“各位叔伯阿姨，兄弟姐妹，张荼应该是到天亮都不一定能醒来，着实是累得很，所以你们也各自休息去吧。”
“这会儿离天亮还远着呢，是不是。放心，张荼是你们看着长大的，也不是会忘记各位的。要不然，我们也没有必要回来，也没有必要冒险只为了除掉这个可能威胁到你们的畜生，你们说是不是啊。”
边关月的声音刚说完，众人纷纷响应。
“小哥说得没错，我们先休息，明天再来看荼荼吧，让他好好休息吧。”
“对啊，对啊，顺圣和缃叶奔波了一路，也要休息啊，听他们说，这天地大了足足十倍呢，反正不急于一时，我们就先回去吧。”
“走吧，走吧。”
在一片寒暄之中，众人开始有序地告辞，还有不少人则是欢天喜地地去瓜分着巨大的野猪肉，人家边关月都说了，这玩意持着补，还鲜嫩，是难得野味。
张寰随着父亲在熙攘的人流中向着家的方向走去。
content_en:
The blurred starlight flashed faintly in the faint clouds and smoke. The topic in the courtyard gradually changed uncontrollably. Amid a group of juniors scratching their heads and scratching their heads, the topic gradually shifted from Zhang Tu's ability to the topic of male students getting married and girls getting married.
Fu Xiangye nodded in agreement with deep sympathy.
After Zhang Shunsheng made a circle of cigarettes, he lit it and took a puff, and said helplessly: "You can't help me when you grow up. You are spoiled by your mother. Whatever I say, just listen to it when you are happy. If you are unhappy, pretend you didn't hear it."
"How can you say that about your own child? Xiaotu has always been filial and obedient. It must be your bad attitude."
An aunt whose appearance was unclear interrupted, but her eyes flashed with the unique wisdom of villagers: "Tell the truth, does Xiao Tu have someone he likes?"
Fu Xianye hesitated for a moment, and then said: "There should be, maybe not. He has always hidden his thoughts very deeply, but whether there is or not, there is not much hope."
After Zhang Tu left, and then there was a mysterious Bian Guanyue following him, Fu Xiangye knew that there must be some conflict between the two of them on Yun Shang's side.
She knew Liu Jinyu. Yun Shang once said when she came to the house that it was in the community next door. This silly kid might have found out after taking a walk that Yun Shang should be on this side of the river.
Everything went as Fu Xianye expected, and he really knew his son better than his mother.
After hearing Fu Xianye's words, the aunt slapped her thigh and raised her voice a little higher, but then quickly lowered her voice: "Okay! Isn't it over? What makes little Tutu hesitate now is having a master? How can a proud and arrogant master like our Xiaotu go back and take the initiative to pester those who have a master?"
"You can't waste it. I said Tu Tu's mother, you are doing it according to Tu's wishes, and it will take many years." Another aunt on the side said in the words of someone who has experienced it: "There is a man in the village next door who is just like this. He is not destined to be so lucky. He has been delayed until he is over forty years old, and he has no one to warm his bed. Not to mention how pitiful he is."
Fu Xianye looked at the enthusiastic faces of his neighbors and always felt that something was wrong, but at the same time he felt that everything was right.
Seeing Fu Xiangye's hesitation, the first aunt laughed and said: "If nothing else, aren't there a few Zhuangzi around us who are all beautiful? Although their knowledge and knowledge are not as good as those of the ladies in the city, when it comes to knowing the warmth and warmth and serving people, how can those young ladies compare to them?"
I don't know whether it was emotion or something else, but the aunt's voice was slightly low, with an indescribable charm: "After all, people in small places are more discerning..."
When Zhang Shunsheng heard this, he felt that he was right and said tentatively: "Xianye, how about... just listen to the two sisters-in-law? Check it with Tutu first, and then introduce it to Tutu if you find someone who is good. You know the basics, don't worry, right? With that lad's lazy look, if he is not someone who knows how to serve others, I would be really worried."
Fu Xianye was still thinking about Yun Shang's appearance, and Xiao Nizi, who would send greeting videos during the holidays in the past two years. Although they had never met in person, there was no shortage of greetings, gifts and care.
But it makes sense when you think about it. Although the girls in the city are nice, how can they compare to the girls from the farmhouse who are as diligent and good at serving others?
Fu Xiangye gritted his teeth and said, "It's not an option to go on like this. Let's just do it like this. Please pay more attention to the two sisters-in-law. If there are good girls, let's meet them first, right?"
"Easy to say, easy to say."
Bian Guanyue, who was outside the door, couldn't help laughing when she heard the change of topic. She suppressed her smile and dragged a hind leg into the yard. Everyone couldn't help but be shocked when they saw the hind leg that was almost as wide as the door.
Is this Zhang Tu killing the wild boar that appears around Zhuangzi on his own?
"So big!"
"This wild boar... what a brave boy."
Zhang Shunsheng looked at Bian Guanyue, who was neither blushing nor out of breath. His eyes were slightly drooped, but in his heart, he had a rough assessment of this humble Bian Guanyue. What a good guy, he has so much strength.
Especially when he noticed that Bian Guanyue's footsteps did not leave any footprints even if they stepped on the soft mud. He couldn't help but guess in his heart, was Zhang Tu's creation related to Bian Guanyue?
Bian Guanyue dragged the pork leg to a corner and said with a smile: "Uncle, aunt, you can handle it when it gets daylight. The quality of this meat is absolutely delicious. I don't know how to cook this, otherwise I wouldn't bother you two."
Zhang Shunsheng happily handed over a cigarette and said: "Xiaobianguan, don't be so polite. When you come here, treat it as if you are at home. I will leave these matters to my uncle. By the way, Tutu is sleeping very hard, is there really no problem?"
Bian Guanyue followed the example of others, put the cigarette in her ear, and said: "It doesn't matter, let him have a good rest, it will be good for his body."
After he finished speaking, he turned around and said to everyone: "Uncles, aunts, brothers and sisters, Zhang Tu may not be able to wake up until dawn. He is really tired, so you should go and have some rest."
"It's still far from dawn now, isn't it? Don't worry, you have watched Zhang Tu grow up, and he will not forget you. Otherwise, there is no need for us to come back, and there is no need to take risks just to get rid of this beast that may threaten you, don't you think?"
As soon as Bian Guanyue finished speaking, everyone responded.
"Brother is right. Let's rest first and come see Tutu tomorrow. Let him have a good rest."
"Yes, that's right. Shunsheng and Xiangye have been running all the way and they need to rest. I heard them say that the world is ten times bigger. Anyway, we are not in a hurry, so let's go back first."
"Let's go, let's go."
